QuestInfo.name: Reaching Equilibrium
QuestInfo.0: With the power of the Auguries, you used the Light within you to overcome the Dark.
QuestInfo.1: With the power of the Auguries, you used the Light within you to overcome the Dark.
QuestInfo.2: Now you should be able to meet Lania again.

0.0: Well? How you feeling?\r\n#L0##bIt was a shock, but I feel better.#l\n#k
0.1: A shock? That's all? Haw! Don't you realize no one's ever done this before? You're a first!\r\n#L0##bYou expected more than a shock? Is my life so trivial to you?#l\n#k
0.2: You may have conquered your darkness, but you still need to lighten up.\r\n#L0##bEnough jest. I seek to understand what happened... The Dark is not gone, but rather under my control. In fact, it seems to be even more a part of me than before.#l\n#k
0.3: You aren't wrong. I reckon you've unlocked the power to balance both Light and Dark magic together.\r\n#L0##bMore importantly, I no longer need worry about losing control. I can finally return to Lania...#l\n#k
